description: Denoisers used by the MATLAB simulations (scripts/infer/*_mat.py) and by scripts/test/*.py. name: chain label (letters, digits, _); version: pdnet (RDPDNet, models/bases/pdnet.py) or dncnn; checkpoint: relative to alg_pdisac (written by scripts/train/train_<model>_<afm|no_afm>.py). A missing checkpoint is skipped with a warning unless the model is requested by name.
